title: Operating Outside an Applicant’s Home QA
content:
G4ABC (Home QA: EU #8) operates the CQ WW CW contest from Italy (QA: EU #5). Because the
station is physically located in Italy, G4ABC’s Event Score is calculated using the Maximum Score from
EU #5, not EU #8. The resulting Event Score is credited to G4ABC’s Home QA (EU #8) standings, but
it counts against their limit of three (3) allowed “Outside-QA” scores.

title: Standard Multi-Operator Calculation
content:
G4ABC has a published score of 3,000,000 points in CQ WPX CW (Value = 950) as an M2 entry
(Weighting Factor = 0.85) from EU #8. The Maximum Score in the M2 category in EU #8 is 4,000,000
points. Up to 6 operators at G4ABC may submit this result.
Calculation: 950 × 0.85 × (3,000,000 / 4,000,000) = 605.6 WRTC points

title: Lower-Category Score Substitution (Table 5 Rule)
content:
Using the scenario from Example 2, suppose there was an MS entry (a lower category in Table 5) in
EU #8 that achieved a published score of 5,000,000 points. Because the MS score (5,000,000) is
higher than the top M2 score (4,000,000), the MS score becomes the new "Maximum Score"
denominator for all M2 entrants. G4ABC still uses the M2 Weighting Factor (0.85).
Calculation: 950 × 0.85 × (3,000,000 / 5,000,000) = 484.5 WRTC points
Sub-area Normalization Examples (Table 4)
Sub-Areas ensure that competitors in massive geographic zones are only compared against stations
with similar propagation realities.

title: NA #10 (Standard Sub-Area Comparison)
content:
In the ARRL DX SSB Contest (Value = 900 for domestic), VE1BBB operates SO LP (WF = 0.90) from
Sub-Area 1 (closer to EU). The Maximum Score in Sub-Area 1 is 3,000,000. VE4AAA operates SO LP
from Sub-Area 2 (a tougher path to EU), where the Maximum Score is 1,500,000.
▪ VE1BBB scores 2,000,000. Calculation: 900 × 0.90 × (2,000,000 / 3,000,000) = 540.0 WRTC
points
▪ VE4AAA scores 1,000,000. Calculation: 900 × 0.90 × (1,000,000 / 1,500,000) = 540.0 WRTC
points



Result: Even though VE4AAA’s raw contest score is half of VE1BBB’s due to propagation
disadvantages, the Sub-Area normalization allows both operators to earn the exact same WRTC
qualification score.

title: AF #1 (Africa North/West vs. South/East)
content:
In CQ WW CW (Value = 1000), CN8AA operates SO HP (WF = 1.0) from Sub-Area 1 (North/West). The
Maximum Score in Sub-Area 1 is 8,000,000. ZS6XYZ operates SO HP from Sub-Area 2 (South/East),
where the Maximum Score is 4,000,000.
▪ CN8AA scores 5,000,000. Calculation: 1000 × 1.0 × (5,000,000 / 8,000,000) = 625.0 WRTC
points
▪ ZS6XYZ scores 3,000,000. Calculation: 1000 × 1.0 × (3,000,000 / 4,000,000) = 750.0 WRTC
points

title: SA #2 (South America North vs. South)
content:
In CQ WPX SSB (Value = 950), HK3A operates SOA LP (WF = 0.90) from Sub-Area 1 (North). The
Maximum Score in Sub-Area 1 is 6,000,000. CE3BB operates SOA LP from Sub-Area 2 (South), where
the Maximum Score is 5,000,000.
▪ HK3A scores 6,000,000. Calculation: 950 × 0.90 × (6,000,000 / 6,000,000) = 855.0 WRTC
points
▪ CE3BB scores 4,000,000. Calculation: 950 × 0.90 × (4,000,000 / 5,000,000) = 684.0 WRTC
points

title: EU #1 (North vs. South)
content:
In WAE DX CW (Value = 900 for EU), OH2A operates MS (WF = 0.90) from Sub-Area 1 (North). The
Maximum Score in Sub-Area 1 is 4,000,000. YL2B operates MS from Sub-Area 2 (South), where the
Maximum Score is 5,000,000.
▪ OH2A scores 2,000,000. Calculation: 900 × 0.90 × (2,000,000 / 4,000,000) = 405.0 WRTC
points
▪ YL2B scores 3,000,000. Calculation: 900 × 0.90 × (3,000,000 / 5,000,000) = 486.0 WRTC
points

title: NA #1 (W1 vs. W2 vs. W3)
content:
In the IARU HF Championship (Value = 1000), K1AA operates SO HP (WF = 1.0) from Sub-Area 1 (W1).
The Maximum Score in Sub-Area 1 is 4,000,000. N3CC operates SO HP from Sub-Area 3 (W3), where
the Maximum Score is 2,500,000.
▪ K1AA scores 3,000,000. Calculation: 1000 × 1.0 × (3,000,000 / 4,000,000) = 750.0 WRTC
points
▪ N3CC scores 2,000,000. Calculation: 1000 × 1.0 × (2,000,000 / 2,500,000) = 800.0 WRTC
points



Score Calculation Examples

title: NA #6 (North vs. South)
content:
In All Asian DX CW (Value = 800 for NA), K7WA operates SO LP (WF = 0.90) from Sub-Area 1 (North -
WA/OR/ID/MT/WY). The Maximum Score in Sub-Area 1 is 1,000,000. N7NV operates SO LP from
Sub-Area 2 (South - NV/UT/AZ), where the Maximum Score is 800,000.
▪ K7WA scores 500,000. Calculation: 800 × 0.90 × (500,000 / 1,000,000) = 360.0 WRTC points
▪ N7NV scores 800,000. Calculation: 800 × 0.90 × (800,000 / 800,000) = 720.0 WRTC points

title: NA #10 (ARRL DX Exception for KL7)
content:
Because Alaska (KL7) faces unique propagation in the ARRL DX contest compared to the rest of
Western Canada, they are separated into their own Sub-Area exclusively for this event. VE6XX
operates M2 (WF = 0.85) from Sub-Area 1 (VE4-8, VY1). The Maximum Score is 5,000,000. KL7YY
operates M2 from Sub-Area 2 (KL7), where the Maximum Score is 2,000,000.
▪ VE6XX scores 4,000,000. Calculation: 900 × 0.85 × (4,000,000 / 5,000,000) = 612.0 WRTC
points
▪ KL7YY scores 2,000,000. Calculation: 900 × 0.85 × (2,000,000 / 2,000,000) = 765.0 WRTC
points
